migrations.detect: project compatibility returns MIGRATION_REQUIRED with detected_format 0.4-unversioned for a populated legacy .vibehub/context/ directory.
steps: Before writing, preview every legacy Context path and every Ticket context_ref that will change; cross the explicit migration boundary once for this reviewed set.
When .vibehub/rooms/ is missing or empty, build the Room tree first with the distill skill (cold start); do not invent rooms for territory you have not read.
Move every entry out of .vibehub/context/ into the lowest room that owns its claim, per the placement rule in the knowledge-governance reference, using git mv; remove the emptied directory.
Rewrite every ticket context_ref that names a .vibehub/context/ path to the entry's new roomed path.
Continue with the 0.5-unversioned-to-format-1 step and every following format step; the room move alone is not the current project format.

migrations.detect: project compatibility returns MIGRATION_REQUIRED with detected_format 0.5-unversioned after the Room layout is present but .vibehub/version.yaml is absent.
steps: Preview the one new checked-in path .vibehub/version.yaml and confirm that the repository no longer contains populated legacy .vibehub/context/ entries.
After the explicit migration boundary, write .vibehub/version.yaml with schema_version 1, kind vibehub_project, and integer format_version 1.
Continue with the format-1-to-format-2 step; format 1 is no longer current.

migrations.detect: project compatibility returns MIGRATION_REQUIRED with detected_format 1 and target_format 2 after Ticket delivery membership became canonical project data.
steps: Preview every canonical Ticket and classify its delivery membership from exact reviewable history; do not infer delivery from Ticket status, branch name, filename, prose, or whichever pull request is currently open.

Upgrade every Ticket document from schema_version 1 to schema_version 2 and add an explicit deliveries array. For a delivered pull request, record its canonical GitHub pull request URL, state delivered, exact mergedAt timestamp, and 40-hex merge commit. For an exact delivered cherry-pick, record the commit ref, timestamp, and delivered commit. Leave an empty array when no authoritative delivery can be established.
After the reviewed Ticket audit, write .vibehub/version.yaml with schema_version 1, kind vibehub_project, and integer format_version 2.
Continue with the format-2-to-format-3 step; format 2 is no longer current.

migrations.detect: project compatibility returns MIGRATION_REQUIRED with detected_format 2 and target_format 3 after Evidence and Outcomes gained their optional acceptance-contract binding.
steps: Run the deterministic dry run and review its impact report before writing anything: node scripts/migrate-proof-bindings.mjs --repo <root> (from this Skill's folder). Every count in the report is recomputed at the migration HEAD; nothing is hard-coded.

After the explicit migration boundary, run the same migrator with --apply. It upgrades every Evidence document from schema_version 1 to schema_version 2 with a reconstructed acceptance_bindings array, and every Outcome document from schema_version 1 to schema_version 2 with a reconstructed contract_binding, reading each document's owning Ticket at its first Git addition on the current HEAD ancestry only. The addition commit is recorded as provenance_ref — provenance, never identity. Missing, ambiguous, or since-drifted history becomes an unresolved marker (no-addition-commit, ticket-unreadable-at-addition, referenced-acceptance-missing-at-addition, contract-drifted-since-addition) rather than a fabricated binding, and every other byte of the historical document is preserved.

The apply finishes by writing .vibehub/version.yaml with integer format_version 3 and verifying that the on-disk retention counts equal the dry-run report; a second apply at the same HEAD is byte-identical and reproduces the same unresolved set.

Prove project compatibility returns CURRENT, project validate and ticket validate pass, and review the diff as ordinary Git changes: an unresolved successful Outcome now projects REPLAN with reason unresolved_legacy_outcome and stale Evidence stops satisfying acceptance coverage.
migrations.rollback: Restore the format 2 interpretation by reverting .vibehub/version.yaml to format_version 2 together with the matching plugin version. Bindings stay in place and are inert under format 2; no historical document is deleted or rewritten, and reapplying the migration at the same HEAD reproduces byte-identical bindings and the same unresolved set.
